reproduction_target: Computational scRNA-seq analysis of PBMCs from 8 subjects (4 AUD, 4 control): read-to-count-matrix generation, QC cell/gene filtering, Seurat v4.3.0 normalization + variable-feature selection + PCA + UMAP, CCA-anchor integration (batch correction), clustering into 5 major and 25 immune sub-clusters, CellMarker-database-based cell-type annotation, Wilcoxon differential expression (AUD vs control, high/low DpDD, TD strata; sex-stratified), and GO/Hallmark/KEGG/REACTOME over-representation analysis.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-operation from the biorxiv v1 HTML full-text Methods (JATS source.xml returned HTTP 403; landing/.full HTML retrieved via curl and used as the equivalent methods source). CRITICAL: the retrievable full text contains NO Data-availability statement and NO Code-availability statement and no GEO/SRA/dbGaP/EGA/GitHub/Zenodo identifier anywhere. Only one software version is pinned in prose (Seurat v4.3.0). The read-alignment / count-matrix tool (typically Cell Ranger for 10X) and the over-representation-analysis tool are not named at all. All computational steps therefore cap at NI (data axis 0 for every step — input data not obtainable). Wet-lab library-prep/sequencing steps counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Read alignment / count-matrix generation from 10X Chromium 3' v3.1 NovaSeq reads — tool NOT named (Cell Ranger implied but not stated), no version
QC cell/gene filtering (min 100 genes, max 6,500 genes, mito proportion < 25%, genes expressed in >= 3 cells) — Seurat v4.3.0
Normalization + variable-feature identification + dimensionality reduction (PCA, UMAP) — Seurat v4.3.0 (default methods, parameters not fully enumerated)
Cross-sample integration via canonical-correlation-analysis integration anchors (batch-effect removal), scaling, integrated-dataset dimensionality reduction — Seurat v4.3.0
Clustering into 5 major immune clusters, sub-clustered into 25 clusters — Seurat v4.3.0 (resolution/algorithm not stated)
Cell-type annotation: cluster marker genes compared to markers curated from CellMarker databases + literature — CellMarker (no version, no snapshot date)
Differential expression: Seurat default Wilcoxon Rank Sum test, min log2FC 0.25, genes expressed in >= 25% of cells in either group (AUD vs control, DpDD, TD strata; sex-stratified) — Seurat v4.3.0
Over-representation / pathway-enrichment analysis of DEGs against GO, Hallmark, KEGG, REACTOME gene sets — analysis tool NOT named, no version, gene-set DB versions not stated
